person.name: Shreeya Kumbhoje
person.summary: AI & Data Scientist based in London, passionate about LLMs, RAG pipelines, and turning data into decisions. Experienced in building intelligent systems that actually matter.

visa.note: Requires UK visa sponsorship. Currently on a Graduate Visa expiring January 2027.

achievements: Reduced manual support queries by ~30% by building a GenAI-powered semantic search system over 100+ operational documents via a RAG pipeline (Groq LLM, FAISS, BGE-base-en-v1.5)
Increased operational efficiency by 35% by developing a GPT-4.1 powered KPI insight engine integrating live Salesforce and Webfleet data via an ETL pipeline.
Improved marketing targeting accuracy by 25% by independently delivering a customer segmentation dashboard (React, FastAPI, GCP) uncovering high-value segments from 13,000+ records.
Reduced onboarding time by 40% across 335+ users by delivering a centralized LMS (React, Django, Azure Entra ID) with JWT authentication and role-based access control.
Prevented an estimated 30% loss in billable reporting hours by cleaning and validating Azure system logs with Python, eliminating data integrity gaps that masked recurring system failures.
Reduced mean time to detect incidents by ~35% across ERP and DMS clients by managing Power BI dashboards monitoring performance metrics, ensuring consistent cloud infrastructure observability.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver client solutions.
Recovered 25% of lost client contracts within one quarter by building financial projections that drove the decision to prioritise school partnerships, restoring pre-pandemic baseline revenue.
Improved profitability projection accuracy by 15% by conducting field research across multiple vendors, confirming industry-wide pricing increases and updating cost models accordingly.

highlights: Focused on machine learning, NLP, and data engineering.
Dissertation on applied Computer Vision for Semi-Supervised learning based Multi-Object detection.
Final year project on Stock-Trading predictive analytics.

career_gap.explanation: During this period Shreeya was actively applying for roles in the UK market, which was highly competitive. She used this time productively by completing her MSc at the University of Nottingham, building a portfolio of data analysis and ML projects, and completing virtual internships with British Airways, Citi, and Deloitte to gain industry exposure across different sectors.

recruiter_faq.q: Is Shreeya available for work?
recruiter_faq.a: Yes, Shreeya is actively looking for AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or Data Engineer roles in the UK.

recruiter_faq.q: Does Shreeya require visa sponsorship?
recruiter_faq.a: Yes, Shreeya requires UK visa sponsorship. She is currently on a Graduate Visa expiring January 2027.

recruiter_faq.q: Where is Shreeya based?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya is based in London, UK.

recruiter_faq.q: What is Shreeya's strongest technical area?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya's strongest area is LLMs and RAG pipelines, with hands-on production experience building and deploying them. She also has strong Python, data engineering, and full-stack AI product experience.

recruiter_faq.q: Can Shreeya work on-site?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya is open to hybrid and on-site roles in London.

recruiter_faq.q: How can I contact Shreeya?
recruiter_faq.a: You can reach Shreeya at shriyakumbhoje73@gmail.com or via LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreeyakumbhoje/

recruiter_faq.q: What kind of roles is Shreeya looking for?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya is targeting AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or Data Engineer roles — ideally working on LLM-based products, RAG systems, or data infrastructure. She is not looking for pure BI or analyst roles.

recruiter_faq.q: When is Shreeya's Birthday?
recruiter_faq.a: Its on the 17th August 1998.

recruiter_faq.q: What was Shreeya doing in 2024 before her AI Engineer role?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya completed her MSc Data Science at the University of Nottingham in 2024. She was actively applying for roles in a tough UK market, and during that time built multiple data analysis and ML projects and completed virtual internships with British Airways, Citi, and Deloitte to gain broad industry exposure.

recruiter_faq.q: Why is there a gap in Shreeya's CV?
recruiter_faq.a: There is no real gap — Shreeya completed her MSc at Nottingham in 2023-2024, built a portfolio of data and ML projects, and completed virtual internships with British Airways (NLP/ML), Citi (M&A financial modeling), and Deloitte (operational analytics). She was actively upskilling and applying throughout this period in a highly competitive UK job market.

recruiter_faq.q: Does Shreeya know Power BI?
recruiter_faq.a: Yes, Shreeya has used Power BI in professional roles and personal projects, though her primary focus is Python-based AI and ML engineering. Power BI is a supporting skill rather than her main strength.

recruiter_faq.q: Does Shreeya know R?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya has used R in data analysis projects during her MSc, though her primary language is Python. R is a familiar tool rather than a core strength.

recruiter_faq.q: What virtual internships has Shreeya done?
recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya completed three virtual internships in 2024: 1) British Airways (Forage) — NLP and ML project analyzing airline reviews and predicting booking completion using sentiment analysis and Random Forest classification. 2) Citi (Forage) — Buyside M&A investment banking simulation analyzing a potential acquisition of Best Buy through financial modeling and valuation. 3) Deloitte (Forage) — Operational analytics project analyzing machine downtime and gender pay equality using Tableau and industrial telemetry data.

recruiter_faq.q: Tell me about Shreeya's British Airways virtual internship
recruiter_faq.a: As part of the British Airways Forage virtual internship, Shreeya built an NLP and ML system analyzing airline customer reviews. She performed sentiment analysis using TextBlob, built word clouds for insight visualization, and trained a Random Forest classifier with GridSearchCV to predict booking completion. Stack: Python, NLP, TextBlob, Scikit-Learn, RandomForest, GridSearchCV.

recruiter_faq.q: Tell me about Shreeya's Citi virtual internship
recruiter_faq.a: As part of the Citi Forage virtual internship, Shreeya completed a buyside M&A simulation analyzing a potential acquisition of Best Buy. She built financial models, performed company valuation, and delivered a strategic investment analysis presentation. Stack: Excel, Financial Modeling, Valuation, PowerPoint, Market Research.

recruiter_faq.q: Tell me about Shreeya's Deloitte virtual internship
recruiter_faq.a: As part of the Deloitte Forage virtual internship, Shreeya worked on an operational analytics project for Daikibo Industrials. She analyzed machine downtime patterns and built a workforce equity dashboard examining gender pay equality using industrial telemetry and workforce data. Stack: Tableau, Excel, Data Visualization, Classification, Industrial IoT Analytics.

recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya has 3 core AI engineering projects: 1) CORA — AI Portfolio Concierge, a full RAG-powered portfolio assistant using Anthropic Haiku, Voyage AI, and Supabase pgvector. 2) RAG Pipeline for Document Q&A — chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipeline using FAISS, BGE embeddings, and Groq LLM. 3) Data Pipeline Insights Engine — GPT-4.1 powered KPI engine integrating live Salesforce and Webfleet data via ETL. recruiter_faq.a: Shreeya has built 18 projects in total across categories: 3 AI engineering projects (RAG, LLMs), 3 ML engineering projects (Computer Vision, classification), 2 NLP projects, 2 data engineering projects, 6 data analysis projects, and 3 virtual internship projects (British Airways, Citi, Deloitte).
